14.15.title: Bistatic Radar Equation Derivation
14.15.description: Derive the radar equation for the bistatic case where the transmit and receive antennas have gains of $G_t$ and $G_r$, and are at distances $R_t$ and $R_r$ from the target, respectively.
14.15.description_cn: 推导双基地雷达方程，其中发射天线增益为 $G_t$，接收天线增益为 $G_r$，它们到目标的距离分别为 $R_t$ 和 $R_r$。

radar_cross_section.description: Bistatic radar cross section (RCS) of target

steps.title: Power Density at Target
steps.explanation: Power density from transmit antenna at distance $R_t$
steps.explanation_cn: 发射天线在距离 $R_t$ 处的功率密度

steps.title: Power Intercepted and Scattered by Target
steps.title_cn: 目标截获并散射的功率
steps.explanation: Radar cross section $\sigma$ relates incident power density to scattered power (isotropic equivalent)
steps.explanation_cn: 雷达散射截面 $\sigma$ 将入射功率密度与等效各向同性散射功率相关联

steps.title: Power Density at Receiver Location
steps.title_cn: 接收机位置处的功率密度
steps.explanation: Scattered power spreads isotropically from target to receiver distance $R_r$
steps.explanation_cn: 散射功率从目标向接收机各向同性传播，距离为 $R_r$

steps.title: Effective Aperture of Receive Antenna
steps.explanation: Relationship between antenna gain and effective area
steps.explanation_cn: 天线增益与有效面积的关系

steps.title: Received Power
steps.formula: $P_r = S_r \cdot A_{\text{eff},r} = \frac{P_t G_t \sigma}{(4\pi)^2 R_t^2 R_r^2} \cdot \frac{\lambda^2}{4\pi} G_r$ \\ $P_r = \frac{P_t G_t G_r \lambda^2 \sigma}{(4\pi)^3 R_t^2 R_r^2}$
steps.formula_cn: $P_r = S_r \cdot A_{\text{eff},r} = \frac{P_t G_t \sigma}{(4\pi)^2 R_t^2 R_r^2} \cdot \frac{\lambda^2}{4\pi} G_r$ \\ $P_r = \frac{P_t G_t G_r \lambda^2 \sigma}{(4\pi)^3 R_t^2 R_r^2}$

14.15.note: For monostatic radar, $R_t = R_r = R$ and $G_t = G_r = G$, giving $P_r = \frac{P_t G^2 \lambda^2 \sigma}{(4\pi)^3 R^4}$.
14.15.note_cn: 对于单基地雷达，$R_t = R_r = R$ 且 $G_t = G_r = G$，得到 $P_r = \frac{P_t G^2 \lambda^2 \sigma}{(4\pi)^3 R^4}$。
